answers:
The help section lists `uv run agent_cli.py flow --window 6h --limit 4` as the command that shows more flows, but it doesn't say that it shows every flow. The output reports 4 flows total with 2 shown, so `--limit 4` would show all of them.

uv run agent_cli.py flow --window 6h --limit 4
